title: Array representation across disjoint writes
summary: Preserves a represented UInt64 array across allocator writes and later stores above the input region without re-proving its length and element reads.
premises: A cutoff above the complete input representation
Unchanged pages and bytes below the cutoff, or the checked fixed-array allocator premises
A later store whose address begins at or above the cutoff
result: The original input representation, including its length and indexed element reads, remains valid in the modified store.
